# vergeio_network_ipsec (Resource)

`vergeio_network_ipsec` is the IPsec configuration for one network. A network has one. Set `network_id` to `vergeio_network.id`.

VergeOS does not delete IPsec rows when the network is deleted. Destroy of this resource is refused while a phase 1 row remains. [`vergeio_network_ipsec_connection`](network_ipsec_connection.md) deletes phase 2, then phase 1. Deleting phase 1 while a phase 2 row remains fails, and that failure sticks. With the references in the example, Terraform destroys the connection, then this configuration, then the network.

`mode = "advanced"` sends `strongswan_conf`, `ipsec_conf`, and `ipsec_secrets`. The read used by this provider does not return those files, so Terraform keeps the configured text.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One IPsec configuration per network. network_id references the network, so
# Terraform deletes this configuration before the network. Delete connections
# first: phase 2, then phase 1.

resource "vergeio_network" "lan" {
  name = "Example LAN"
}

resource "vergeio_network_ipsec" "lan" {
  network_id = vergeio_network.lan.id
  enabled    = true
  mode       = "normal"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) Network id, the same value as vergeio_network.id. Changing it replaces this resource. A reference creates the destroy edge the platform does not.

### Optional

- `accept_unencrypted_mainmode` (Boolean) Accept unencrypted ID and HASH payloads in IKEv1 main mode. The API read used here does not return it, so Terraform keeps the configured value.
- `cisco_unity` (Boolean) Send the Cisco Unity vendor ID payload. IKEv1 only. The API read used here does not return it, so Terraform keeps the configured value.
- `compress` (Boolean) Propose IPComp compression. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether IPsec is enabled on the network. Defaults to true.
- `exclude_network` (Boolean) Exclude the local subnet from IPsec. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `ipsec_conf` (String, Sensitive) Raw ipsec.conf content for advanced mode. The API read used here does not return it, so Terraform keeps the configured value.
- `ipsec_secrets` (String, Sensitive) Raw ipsec.secrets content for advanced mode. The API read used here does not return it, so Terraform keeps the configured value.
- `make_before_break` (Boolean) Use make-before-break reauthentication. IKEv2 only. The API read used here does not return it, so Terraform keeps the configured value.
- `mode` (String) normal uses the phase 1 and phase 2 resources. advanced uses strongswan_conf, ipsec_conf, and ipsec_secrets. Defaults to normal.
- `mss_clamp` (Number) MSS clamp on installed routes. 0 disables it. The API read used here does not return it, so Terraform keeps the configured value.
- `strictcrlpolicy` (String) CRL validation: yes, ifuri, or no. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `strongswan_conf` (String, Sensitive) Raw strongswan.conf content for advanced mode. The API read used here does not return it, so Terraform keeps the configured value.
- `uniqueids` (String) How duplicate IKE identities are handled: yes, no, never, replace, or keep. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) IPsec configuration id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import vergeio_network_ipsec.example <id>
```
